sources.title: Greek MFA: visas for Greeks travelling abroad
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Hellenic Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Greek MFA traveller page is addressed to Greek citizens travelling outside the EU/EEA and directs them to destination consular authorities for entry-visa requirements.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Έλληνες πολίτες που ταξιδεύουν σε χώρες εκτός Ευρωπαϊκής Ένωσης/ΕΟΧ ... να πληροφορηθούν αν απαιτείται ... θεώρηση εισόδου.

sources.title: Panama MFA: current bilateral-treaty register for Greece
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Republic of Panama
sources.officialityEvidence: Panama MFA's current bilateral-treaty register has a Greece entry that expressly includes ordinary passports in the visa-suppression agreement and records entry into force.
sources.supportingExcerpt: ACUERDO PARA LA SUPRESION DE VISAS EN LOS PASAPORTES ORDINARIOS, DIPLOMATICOS Y OFICIALES.

sources.title: Bangladesh Special Branch: visa on arrival instructions
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Bangladesh Police Special Branch visa-on-arrival service defines the ordinary visitor facility and expressly includes European-country citizens among eligible tourism travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: European countries to Bangladesh for tourism, trade, investment, or a government job may get a visa on arrival.

policies.title: Greek ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's current Foreign Ministry treaty register records visa suppression for ordinary Greek passports.
conditions: This evidence establishes the ordinary-passport visa-waiver baseline only; it does not establish work, residence, length of stay, carrier, health or final-admission conditions.
The result follows Panama's named Greece ordinary-passport agreement, not an inferred regional or reciprocal complement.

policies.title: Greek ordinary passports: Bangladesh arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Bangladesh's current Special Branch service includes European-country citizens travelling for tourism among the eligible visa-on-arrival cohort.
conditions: The stated route is a maximum 30-day visitor visa issued at the port of entry, and issuance remains at the immigration officer's discretion.

This is a European-country eligibility class that directly includes Greece, not a conclusion from a general online application portal. Work, residence, special passports, carrier conditions and final admission remain separate.

unresolved.reason: The live evisa.td service claims universal online processing, but no independently retrievable central-government page authenticates or links the service. The existing Chad residual audit therefore still controls, and this pair remains unresolved.
